RPG-IMPACT BLOOM — fresh RPG-rocket detonating against a shattered concrete pillar at the squad's flank, debris-cloud erupting outward in slow-motion orange-white, lead trooper dropping shoulder into brace as shrapnel-fragments scatter past, secondary fires igniting along the rubble-line.

BREACHING-CHARGE DETONATION — squad-placed breaching charge mid-detonation against a reinforced blast-door, door-slab blowing inward in frame-frozen slow-motion, dust and hot metal expanding outward, two troopers already weapons-up on either side of the breach threshold.

SUPPRESSING-FIRE TRACER-WALLS — enemy fire-curtains crossing the frame in arcing hot-white and crimson tracer-lines, squad pressed low mid-advance beneath them, tracers clipping the upper-frame in motion-blur streaks, dirt kicking up across the advance-lane under the fire-wall.

DISTANT-VEHICLE EXPLOSION — enemy APC just destroyed at mid-distance, turret spinning skyward in silhouette, secondary ammunition cooking off in chain-bursts, black smoke-column rising thick and fast, fire-glow painting the squad's armor rear-edge in amber.

DROP-POD ATMOSPHERIC IMPACT — friendly drop-pod slamming into rubble-ground sixty meters out, dust-ring expanding radially at ground-level, pod-hatches blowing open still venting superheated plasma-steam, armored troopers emerging weapons-raised into the combat zone immediately.

MORTAR WALKS GROUND — sequential mortar-impacts walking a line across open ground directly past the squad, dust-columns rising in evenly-spaced succession, squad bracing in sequence as each impact draws closer, debris-spray from the nearest strike crossing the frame edge.

PLASMA-STORM OVERHEAD — enemy plasma-artillery barrage arcing across the sky in vivid blue-violet bolts, ground-impacts at distance throwing dust-pillars, squad heads-down advancing through the storm, plasma-glow casting moving colored shadows across armor plates mid-stride.

BUILDING-COLLAPSE BEHIND — six-story hab-block collapsing directly behind the squad from a direct artillery-strike, dust-wave rolling outward at ground-level toward camera, chunks of rebar-threaded concrete tumbling into the street, squad forward-momentum unbroken as debris rains around them.

WALL-OF-FIRE FOREGROUND — flamethrower-burst erupting across the foreground in a lateral wall of churning orange-white flame, squad backlit hard edge-orange against the fire-wall, heat-shimmer warping the air above, enemy shapes briefly silhouetted inside the burn-front before collapsing.

AERIAL-STRAFE OVERHEAD — friendly gunship strafing pass tearing across overhead, multi-barrel weapon-flashes strobing above the squad, spent brass falling in motion-blur golden rain, exhaust-contrails crossing the upper frame, strike-impacts detonating along the enemy trenchline ahead in sequence.

GROUND-CRACK FROM TITAN-FOOTFALL — titan-class enemy walker footfall impacting distant ground, visible crack-line splitting outward across cracked pavement toward the squad's position, dust-jets escaping the crack, squad stumbling mid-stride to regain footing as the ground-shock rolls underfoot.

GRENADE-BLOOM MIDGROUND — fragmentation grenade detonating at midground between squad and fortified enemy position, frag-spread frozen mid-burst in a spherical debris-pattern, dirt-cloud momentarily over-exposing the frame-center, enemy position briefly visible through the blast-gap before smoke fills in.

CHEMICAL-CLOUD ROLLING — sickly yellow-green chemical-warfare cloud rolling low across a rubble-strewn avenue, squad advancing weapons-up in full respirator-helms, distant enemy figures dissolving into the haze ahead, cloud-tendrils curling around armor joints and leg-plates at ground-level.

CARRIER-AIRSHIP LOOMING — massive friendly carrier-airship dominating the upper background of the battlezone, chassis-bay doors open wide, three dropships visibly deploying downward from the bays, scale dwarfing the burning cityscape below, squad below reading as small against its hull-shadow.

VEHICLE-WRECK FIREBALL — destroyed enemy tank mid-fireball in the midground, turret-hatch blown skyward trailing flame, secondary munitions cooking off in staccato bursts, black oily smoke-column rising, fire-glow uplighting the squad's chest-plates and helmet-visors from below in deep amber.

ALIEN-CREATURE SWARM CLOSING — chitinous alien-biped swarm resolving out of distant smoke at a dead sprint, leading shapes already large enough to read as individual threats, squad front-rank dropping to kneeling firing-stance, weapons-up, muzzle-flashes beginning to cut into the swarm's front edge.

AIRBORNE-DEBRIS RAIN — concrete chunks and twisted metal-fragments from a prior artillery-detonation still raining down across the squad's position, each piece trailing dust-streaks in slow-motion descent, squad members visibly tracking overhead debris, one trooper raising a forearm deflection-guard against incoming fragment.

SNIPER-ROUND IMPACT — incoming hypersonic sniper-round striking cover immediately beside the lead trooper's helmet, sparks and pulverized concrete spraying outward in a tight fan, lead trooper snapping head back and dropping below cover-line in immediate reflex, near-miss energy reading violent and immediate.

DROP-SHIP DEPLOYMENT OVERHEAD — friendly drop-ship ramp-open directly overhead, rappel-lines extending downward in parallel, four armored troopers mid-descent on the lines, boots-first toward the rubble-field below, dust kicked into spirals by the drop-ship's thruster-wash, squad below already covering the landing-zone.

SMOKE-GRENADE BLOOM — two friendly smoke grenades blooming simultaneously across the lower frame in dense gray-white billows, squad advancing through the bloom weapons-up, upper torsos and helmets briefly clear above the smoke-line before the cloud rises to engulf them fully.
